title: ר' שמעון בן יהודה איש כפר עכו

paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Yehudah of Kefar Akko. In Mekhilta, Yitro, Ba-Hodesh ha-Shelishi, chapter 7: the man of Kefar Akko, in R' Shimon's name. Likewise Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 11; in that matter in chapter 12, “in R' Meir's name” is a scribal error. In Sotah 37b: the man of Kefar Akko in R' Shimon's name, “There is no commandment for which forty-eight covenants were not made.” Rabbi said, “According to his words ….” In that matter in Jerusalem Sotah, Ellu Ne'emarin, halakhah 4: Kefar Ammos. In Mishnah Shevuot 1:5: “R' Shimon ben Yehudah in his name,” meaning in R' Shimon's name. In Hullin, Ha-Or ve-ha-Rotev, 122b, and there, 55 end of side b, he is called the man of Kefar Eikhus in R' Shimon's name. In Zevahim 28: Kefar Enosh in R' Shimon's name; see his entry. In Jerusalem Helek, halakhah 6 [the parallel in the checked edition is at 10:5:2]: the man of Kefar Akhus in R' Shimon's name. In R' Shimon's name: Ketubbot 39 end of side a, 41, 73; Bava Kamma 59, 93b; Bava Batra 102; Sanhedrin 12, 110b; Mishnah Makkot 3:6, 21; Menahot 101; Bekhorot 10, 11, 21, 26, 42, 56, 57, 59; Temurah 19b; Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 11; Nega'im, chapter 10, mishnah 8; and Sifra, Kedoshim. In Mishnah Ma'aser Sheni 3:6, in R' Yose's name. In Bava Kamma 59a, in R' Shimon ben Menasya's name. In R' Shimon's name: Shabbat 79, beginning of side b, and 75; Rosh Hashanah 15a; Nazir 40a; Helek 12b, 110b; Niddah 52b, without mentioning “the man of Kefar.” In Shevuot 2, 19b: R' Shimon ben Yehudah and R' Elazar son of R' Shimon. In Sotah 37, 45, in R' Shimon's name. In Tosefta Sotah, end of chapter 8: Kefar Akkum in R' Shimon's name. In Zevahim, chapter 2: Kefar Avus. Kefar Akkum: Tosefta Nega'im, chapter 7 [the checked edition has the parallel at 6:1 and reads Kefar Akko]. He saw stones with leprous marks in Galilee: Sanhedrin 71a, Kefar Akko. It appears that he was the brother of R' Yose son of R' Yehudah bar Illai. Rambam writes that he is mentioned in the Mishnah only in the first chapter of Shevuot. But I have shown you that he is also mentioned in Ma'aser Sheni chapter 3, Makkot chapter 3, and Nega'im chapter 10. R' Shimon ben Yehudah in R' Yose's name: Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni, chapter 1 [the parallel in the checked edition is at 2:11]. In R' Shimon's name: there, Bikkurim and Kiddushin chapter 4. R' Shimon ben Yehudah in R' Akiva's name: Jerusalem Ha-Kones, halakhah 2. In R' Yishmael's name: Ketubbot 73b.
